harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up btrfs-backed filesystem snapshotting for /srv/data on node1 (RHEL7; no LVM, rsync, or yum repos available, so used btrfs which was already present via btrfs-progs + a loadable kernel module). Created a loop-backed btrfs image persistently mounted at /srv/data (subvol=current) via /etc/fstab (nofail), populated application data, took a read-only snapshot (snapshots/baseline), modified the live data (edited a config file, deleted a file, added a new file), then restored by deleting the 'current' subvolume and recreating it as a writable snapshot of 'baseline' — verified via SHA-256 manifest diff that restored content matched the original snapshot exactly. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id and data/mount health baseline, issued systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified /srv/data auto-remounted with both btrfs subvolumes intact and data checksums identical to the pre-restart baseline.
actions_performed: Surveyed node1: RHEL7, single fully-partitioned disk (no free space/LVM), yum repos disabled (no package install possible); btrfs-progs and kernel btrfs module were already available

Created loop-backed image /var/lib/btrfs-backing/data.img, formatted as btrfs, created a 'current' subvolume, added a persistent /etc/fstab entry (loop,subvol=current,nofail) and /etc/modules-load.d/btrfs.conf, mounted at /srv/data
Populated /srv/data with application data (config, db, logs) and recorded a SHA-256 manifest as the baseline
Took a read-only btrfs snapshot 'snapshots/baseline' of the 'current' subvolume via a temporary admin mount of the top-level volume
Modified /srv/data (changed config file, deleted a file, added a new file) and confirmed via manifest diff that content diverged from baseline

Restored exact baseline content: unmounted /srv/data, deleted the 'current' subvolume, created a writable snapshot of 'baseline' named 'current', remounted /srv/data, and confirmed via SHA-256 manifest diff that restored content matched baseline exactly
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, mount state, data checksums, fstab/module persistence config, and snapshot list
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 with ack returned before disconnect; polled until command execution was available again
Verified boot_id changed (fe422859... -> 9114851d...), confirming an actual restart occurred

Verified post-restart recovery: /srv/data auto-mounted via fstab, both btrfs subvolumes ('current' and 'snapshots/baseline') present, and data checksums identical to pre-restart baseline (sudo diff confirmed no differences)

evidence.requirement: Application data under /srv/data made recoverable via filesystem snapshots (baseline setup)
evidence.summary: Created btrfs filesystem, 'current' subvolume mounted at /srv/data, populated app data, and took read-only snapshot 'snapshots/baseline' with recorded SHA-256 manifest
STEP8 modified config file, deleted data.csv, added newfile.txt; STEP9 manifest diff confirmed divergence from baseline

evidence.requirement: Restore exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: Deleted live 'current' subvolume, recreated it as a writable snapshot of 'baseline', remounted /srv/data; SHA-256 manifest diff showed zero differences from baseline ('RESTORE MATCHES BASELINE EXACTLY')

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, service/data health) for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60, confirmed /srv/data mount, data checksums, fstab persistence entry, and both btrfs subvolumes present

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, single node only
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded nohup; ack printed then SSH connection closed by remote host, confirming reboot initiated

evidence.requirement: Node reachable again and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node still rebooting); second poll succeeded with new boot_id 9114851d-3191-4b7a-b6bb-4713e840d935, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services/data and cluster state
evidence.summary: /srv/data auto-remounted (subvol=current), both btrfs subvolumes intact, btrfs module reloaded, and sudo diff confirmed post-reboot data manifest matches the original pre-restart baseline exactly
